Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Receipt of the Order from the Competition Commission of India This is to inform that the Competition Commission of India (CCI) has passed a prima facie Order dated 1 st July 2025 under Section 26(1) of the Competition Act, 2002 , directing the Director General to initiate an investigation against the Company. This action is based on information received from Grasim Industries Limited (Birla Paints Division). Subject: Clarification letter Re: Your email dated June 2, 2025, regarding Clarification for Financial results - INFY We wish to inform you that, t he clause being referred is under Reg 33 (3)(e) is replicated below for reference: The listed entity shall also submit the audited or limited reviewed financial results in respect of the last quarter along-with the results for the entire financial year, with a note stating that the figures of last quarter are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of the full financial year and the published year-to-date figures upto the third quarter of the current financial year Our response – As per the SEBI clause a note has to be given stating that the last quarter figures (Q4) is the balancing figure of year to date figures for the full year and the figures published till Q3 of that year.

Subject to no further adverse weather conditions, we expect to resume normal operations from Monday, August 25, 2025, as tomorrow is a scheduled weekly off. We are currently assessing any potential damage to assets. However, we wish to clarify that all assets are adequately insured.
